method: M0/M1/M3: retroreflector on each spool axis, back-projected onto the calipered z = 33.5 mm plane (vision/bin/measure_anchors.py). M2: caliper trilateration, kept because it is 0.07 mm against 2-4 mm for the optical route.

calipers_mm.0: y = 144.5 past the row-37 hole line
calipers_mm.3: y = -139.5, i.e. 139.5 past the row-0 hole line

note: spools replaced 2026-08-02 with McMaster 6245K418 pulleys; the shaft axes -- and therefore these anchors -- did not move, but the retroreflective markers and their 33.5 mm height belonged to the old spools, so re-measure both before re-running measure_anchors.py
validation: fitting the plane height to five independent caliper constraints wants 35.0 mm (rms 2.16) against the calipered 33.5 (rms 2.32). Before the 78x38 -> 80x39 grid fix the same fit demanded 24.3 mm, so that 9 mm was the grid error in disguise.
